name: B10-0343/2026 – § 2, point c – Am 4
title: PROPOSAL FOR A DECISION amending the decision of 18 December 2024 on setting up a special committee on the Housing Crisis in the European Union to extend the special committee’s term of office and adjust its responsibilities
part_text: (c) to identify and prioritise all EU legislation relevant to housing and actively participate in the forthcoming housing simplification procedure that the European Commission will deliver in 2027 with a view to accelerating and simplifying permitting and renovation processes while maintaining social and environmental standards set by the Union;
